sentences.zh: 所以周二早些时候，我们知道弗吉尼亚州保罗·马纳福特案的陪审团今天可能会做出裁决。

sentences.en: The case against President Trump's former campaign chairman is the first real test for special counsel
sentences.zh: 针对这位总统前竞选团队主席的案件，是特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的“通俄门”调查的第一次真正考验。

sentences.en: this central Mueller investigation into Russian interference in the American election.
sentences.zh: 这与穆勒对俄罗斯干预美国选举的核心调查是间接相关的。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩，你知道，我们都在关注保罗·马纳福特的审判。

sentences.en: So as we're waiting, we also begin to pick up tips that there could be a plea in the Michael Cohen case in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们等待的时候，我们也开始收到消息，称迈克尔·科恩在纽约的案件可能会达成认罪协议。

sentences.en: Now the latest is that Michael Cohen is likely to be charged by the end of the month with tax and bank crimes evasion.
sentences.zh: 最新的消息是，迈克尔·科恩很可能在月底前被控税务和银行犯罪及逃税。

sentences.en: He's facing potential charges from the Southern District of New York on a variety of counts.
sentences.zh: 他正面临纽约南区联邦检察官办公室的多项指控。

sentences.en: Cohen is also facing an investigation into whether he violated campaign finance laws when he arranged payoffs to two women who claimed to have had affairs with Trump,
sentences.zh: 科恩还面临一项调查，即他在安排向两名声称与特朗普有染的女性支付封口费时，是否违反了竞选财务法，

sentences.en: including adult film actress Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 其中包括成人电影女星斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: Depending on the purpose of the payments, they could be a campaign finance violation if the payments were made with the purpose of influencing the election.
sentences.zh: 根据付款的目的，如果付款是为了影响选举，那么它们可能构成违反竞选财务法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The payment was made just days before the 2016 presidential election, raising questions of campaign financing violations.
sentences.zh: 这笔款项是在2016年总统大选前几天支付的，引发了关于违反竞选财务法的质疑。

sentences.en: So he'd be pleading guilty to campaign fraud because the payments to these two women, Stephanie Clifford and
sentences.zh: 所以他会承认竞选欺诈罪，因为支付给这两名女性——斯蒂芬妮·克利福德和

sentences.en: Karen McDougal, were specifically made a few days before the election, so during the campaign, to avoid the kind of embarrassing information that might turn off voters.
sentences.zh: 凯伦·麦克杜格尔——的款项是在选举前几天，也就是竞选期间专门支付的，目的是为了避免那些可能让选民反感的尴尬信息曝光。

sentences.en: So basically it's a campaign event.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上这是一场竞选活动。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Cohen was facing those charges as well as charges into his business dealings in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以科恩面临这些指控，以及针对他在纽约商业往来的指控。

sentences.en: We didn't know exactly what to expect if he were to appear in court, but we did hear that sometime today he was likely to show up in court.
sentences.zh: 如果他出庭，我们不知道具体会发生什么，但我们确实听说他今天很可能会出庭。

sentences.en: And Joe, what is the big question when it comes to how Cohen is going to plea?
sentences.zh: 乔，当谈到科恩将如何认罪时，最大的问题是什么？

sentences.en: The question was, has he flipped?
sentences.zh: 问题是，他是否倒戈了？

sentences.en: To what degree is he cooperating with prosecutors?
sentences.zh: 他在多大程度上与检察官合作？

sentences.en: And to what degree will we learn the details of that in any court appearance that he made today?
sentences.zh: 我们在他今天出庭时能在多大程度上了解到其中的细节？

sentences.en: And was there a sense of what Cohen was going to do?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于科恩会怎么做，有什么预感吗？

sentences.en: Were we expecting him to flip or did we not know?
sentences.zh: 我们是期待他倒戈，还是我们根本不知道？

sentences.en: We've been watching Cohen go through a series of changes since his offices were raided and he came under direct scrutiny of prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 自从他的办公室被突击搜查并受到检察官的直接审查以来，我们一直在观察科恩经历的一系列变化。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump has a significant number of people.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生身边有很多人。

sentences.en: I'd like to keep myself in that little circle of extremely loyal people.
sentences.zh: 我想让自己保持在那个极度忠诚的小圈子里。

sentences.en: He was long one of the most loyal fixers, aides, and advisors to President
sentences.zh: 他长期以来一直是特朗普总统最忠诚的“清道夫”、助手和顾问之一。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: And we will do what it's necessary to protect him and the office of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 我们将采取必要措施来保护他和总统职位。

sentences.en: He said, in fact, that he would take a bullet for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说过他愿意为唐纳德·特朗普挡子弹。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But as it became clear that prosecutors had seized all kinds of records and tapes that were in Michael
sentences.zh: 但随着检察官查封了迈克尔·科恩手中各种记录和录音带的情况变得明朗，他开始发出一些非常不同的信号。

sentences.en: Cohen's possession, he began sending some very different signals.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子、女儿和儿子拥有我最初的忠诚，而且永远都会如此。

sentences.en: My wife, my daughter, and my son have my first loyalty and always will.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子、女儿和儿子拥有我最初的忠诚，而且永远都会如此。

sentences.en: That his main objective was to protect his family,
sentences.zh: 他的主要目标是保护他的家人，

sentences.en: potentially, and actually quite publicly, offering to cooperate with prosecutors and leaking.
sentences.zh: 可能，而且实际上相当公开地，提出与检察官合作并泄露信息。

sentences.en: Big time.
sentences.zh: 非常严重。

sentences.en: And you guys are good guys.
sentences.zh: 你们都是好人。

sentences.en: Hello, Pastor Scott?
sentences.zh: 你好，斯科特牧师？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Pastor Scott, what's happening?
sentences.zh: 斯科特牧师，发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: Can we use him anymore?
sentences.zh: 我们还能用他吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: No, use him at Mark Burns.
sentences.zh: 不，用马克·伯恩斯。

sentences.en: He, we fought him to...
sentences.zh: 他，我们和他斗争是为了……

sentences.en: I don't mean that.
sentences.zh: 我不是那个意思。

sentences.en: Some tantalizing details of the kind of information he might have about the president if prosecutors wanted to listen to him.
sentences.zh: 如果检察官想听他说，他可能掌握了一些关于总统的诱人细节。

sentences.en: So there was an expectation that whenever he did plea, we would learn of details of whether
sentences.zh: 所以人们预期，无论他何时认罪，我们都会了解到迈克尔·科恩是否以及如何以可能损害总统的方式与检察官合作的细节。

sentences.en: and how Michael Cohen might be cooperating with prosecutors in a way that could damage the president.
sentences.zh: 以及迈克尔·科恩可能以何种方式与检察官合作，从而损害总统。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So based on that kind of evolving approach by Michael Cohen, it seems there's a pretty good reason to suspect that he might decide to cooperate with federal prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 所以基于迈克尔·科恩这种不断演变的态度，似乎有充分的理由怀疑他可能会决定与联邦检察官合作。

sentences.en: What happens on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 周二发生了什么？

sentences.en: So on Tuesday when he shows up in court, we get a guilty plea to eight different counts of campaign finance violations and no sign of explicit cooperation with prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 所以周二当他出庭时，我们得到了他对八项不同竞选财务违规指控的认罪，且没有迹象表明他与检察官有明确的合作。

sentences.en: Today stood up and testified under oath that Donald Trump directed him to commit a crime by making payments to two women for the principal purpose of influencing an election.
sentences.zh: 今天他宣誓作证说，唐纳德·特朗普指示他通过向两名女性支付款项来犯罪，其主要目的是影响选举。

sentences.en: In addition, he makes a statement under oath before the judge that he directed these payments to Stormy Daniels and Cara McDougal at the direction of the candidate.
sentences.zh: 此外，他在法官面前宣誓声明，他是在候选人的指示下向斯托米·丹尼尔斯和卡拉·麦克杜格尔支付了这些款项。

sentences.en: By that, he was referring directly to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他所指的正是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So on the surface, this feels okay for the president because Cohen doesn't flip, right?
sentences.zh: 所以从表面上看，这对总统来说感觉还可以，因为科恩没有倒戈，对吧？

sentences.en: It will be open to debate whether this is better for the president or worse for the president.
sentences.zh: 这对总统来说是更好还是更糟，还有待辩论。

sentences.en: The argument that it's better for the president is that he didn't flip and maybe prosecutors
sentences.zh: 认为这对总统更好的论点是，他没有倒戈，也许检察官由此得出结论，科恩真的没有更多有价值的信息可以提供给他们了。

sentences.en: concluded from that that Cohen didn't have much more value that he could really give them.
sentences.zh: 真的没有更多有价值的信息可以提供给他们了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it could be worse for the president because Cohen has now made a statement
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这可能对总统更糟，因为科恩现在已经宣誓声明，他是在总统的指示下进行了非法竞选捐款，而且显然没有任何来自检察官的交换条件或利益。

sentences.en: under oath that he was directed to make illegal campaign contributions by the president apparently without any kind of exchange or benefit from the prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 他是在总统的指示下进行了非法竞选捐款，显然没有任何来自检察官的交换条件或利益。

sentences.en: In other words, it might have been easier for the president and the people around him
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果迈克尔·科恩是因为从检察官那里获得了某种利益或减刑才做出这些陈述，那么总统及其周围的人可能更容易试图抹黑他的陈述。

sentences.en: to try to discredit the statement that Michael Cohen made if he had made it solely because he got some benefit or relief from the prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 如果他仅仅是因为从检察官那里获得了某种利益或减刑才做出这些陈述，那么总统及其周围的人可能更容易试图抹黑他的陈述。

sentences.en: But in this case, there is no clear indication that he got any such benefit.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，没有明确迹象表明他获得了任何此类利益。

sentences.en: So he was under no particular pressure to make that statement if it weren't true.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这些陈述不是真的，他并没有受到任何特别的压力去做出这些陈述。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So basically, Cohen's not flipping looks pretty bad for President Trump because Cohen is
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，科恩没有倒戈对特朗普总统来说看起来很糟糕，因为科恩正在告诉法官总统参与了这件事，而且他甚至没有从中得到任何好处。

sentences.en: telling a judge that the president was involved in this and he's not even getting anything out of it.
sentences.zh: 因为科恩正在告诉法官总统参与了这件事，而且他甚至没有从中得到任何好处。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has made a direct statement implicating the president in directing his crime in almost any other scenario.
sentences.zh: 他做出了直接陈述，指控总统指示他犯罪，这在几乎任何其他情况下，

sentences.en: The person directing the illegal activity would come under direct indictment from the prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 指示非法活动的人都会受到检察官的直接起诉。

sentences.en: The prosecutors would always be interested in the candidate who is responsible for directing campaign finance contributions rather than an aide, a fixer,
sentences.zh: 检察官总是会对负责指示竞选财务捐款的候选人感兴趣，而不是助手、“清道夫”，

sentences.en: someone who actually carried out the violations because the candidate is the one that has the incentive to make these payments in order to influence the election.
sentences.zh: 或者实际执行违规行为的人，因为候选人才是为了影响选举而有动力进行这些支付的人。

sentences.en: The question is what they do now given that he's the sitting president.
sentences.zh: 问题是，鉴于他是现任总统，他们现在该怎么做。

sentences.en: So let's say, for example, that Michael Cohen had worked for Hillary Clinton and she had lost the election as she did.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，假设迈克尔·科恩曾为希拉里·克林顿工作，而她像当时一样输掉了选举。

sentences.en: And he pled guilty to these charges on behalf of candidate Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他代表候选人希拉里·克林顿对这些指控认罪。

sentences.en: And he said, she told me to do it.
sentences.zh: 他说，是她让我这么做的。

sentences.en: She, you're saying, under these circumstances, would almost certainly be charged as a result.
sentences.zh: 你是说，在这种情况下，她几乎肯定会被起诉。

sentences.en: Almost certainly.
sentences.zh: 几乎肯定。

sentences.en: There's almost no scenario in which a prosecutor would bring charges like this and leave the candidate unindicted as a result of a statement like this from an aide.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何情况，检察官会提出这样的指控，却因为助手这样的陈述而让候选人免于起诉。

sentences.en: So help me understand why that's unlikely to happen in this case against Donald Trump as sitting president.
sentences.zh: 那么请帮我理解，为什么在针对现任总统唐纳德·特朗普的案件中，这种情况不太可能发生。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what prosecutors in the Southern District of New York will do.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道纽约南区的检察官具体会怎么做。

sentences.en: It's the most powerful U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是美国最强大的联邦检察官办公室。

sentences.en: attorney's office in the country.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官办公室。

sentences.en: But longstanding Justice Department guidelines have advised against a prosecution of a sitting president.
sentences.zh: 但长期的司法部指导方针建议不要起诉现任总统。

sentences.en: And it is thought to be, though we'll have to explore the possibilities, that prosecutors in this case would be reluctant to bring a charge directly against a sitting president.
sentences.zh: 人们认为——尽管我们必须探索各种可能性——本案的检察官会不愿直接对现任总统提出指控。

sentences.en: But there are a number of different scenarios that could play out over time.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，可能会出现许多不同的情况。

sentences.en: So this has turned from a theoretical threat to the presidency into something that's going to play out much more in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以这已经从对总统职位的理论威胁，变成了将更多地在实时中上演的事情。

sentences.en: And the prosecutors have a number of different options that they could pursue at this point.
sentences.zh: 检察官在这一点上有许多不同的选择可以追求。

sentences.en: We move now to a federal courthouse in Alexandria, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 我们现在转向弗吉尼亚州亚历山大市的联邦法院。

sentences.en: So how, if at all, does this connect back to what's going on in this other courthouse on Tuesday with Paul Manafort?
sentences.zh: 那么，这与周二在另一个法院进行的保罗·马纳福特案有什么联系（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: We left off that the jurors were debating whether or not to convict him on charges of bank fraud, tax evasion, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 我们离开时，陪审员们正在讨论是否要判他银行欺诈、逃税等罪名成立。

sentences.en: So 4.23 p.m., exactly two minutes after Michael Cohen enters his plea of guilty in the courthouse in
sentences.zh: 所以下午4点23分，就在迈克尔·科恩在纽约法院认罪两分钟后，陪审团回到法庭，告诉保罗·马纳福特案的法官他们已经达成裁决。

sentences.en: New York, the jury comes back and tells the judge in the Paul Manafort case that they've reached a verdict in that trial.
sentences.zh: 陪审团回到法庭，告诉保罗·马纳福特案的法官他们已经达成裁决。

sentences.en: We're on the fourth day of deliberations.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于审议的第四天。

sentences.en: The jury returned a partial verdict of guilty in the Paul Manafort case.
sentences.zh: 陪审团在保罗·马纳福特案中做出了部分有罪裁决。

sentences.en: The jury handed special counsel Robert Mueller his first conviction in the ongoing investigation into Russian meddling in the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 陪审团为特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒赢得了他在针对2016年竞选活动中俄罗斯干预的持续调查中的首次定罪。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort has been found guilty by a jury on eight counts.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特被陪审团裁定八项罪名成立。

sentences.en: Five counts of filing false tax returns, guilty on one count of not filing financial accounts, and guilty on two counts of misleading lenders for loans he applied for.
sentences.zh: 五项提交虚假纳税申报表的罪名，一项未申报金融账户的罪名，以及两项误导贷款人以获取贷款的罪名。

sentences.en: None of those charges, as we said, is directly related to the core inquiry in the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，这些指控中没有一项与穆勒调查的核心调查直接相关。

sentences.en: But here's what may happen.
sentences.zh: 但可能会发生这样的情况。

sentences.en: There is now a process typically that leads to sentencing.
sentences.zh: 现在通常有一个导致量刑的过程。

sentences.en: In that time, there's very likely to be sub-negotiation between Manafort's lawyers and the special counsel's
sentences.zh: 在此期间，马纳福特的律师和特别检察官办公室之间很可能会进行二次谈判，

sentences.en: office over whether or not he has any information that may cause them to recommend a lesser sentence to the judge.
sentences.zh: 讨论他是否掌握任何信息，可能导致他们向法官建议减轻刑罚。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort has, to this date, declined to cooperate with prosecutors in any way, but they now have amassed far more leverage over him than they had before they were able to win
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特迄今为止拒绝以任何方式与检察官合作，但他们现在对他拥有的筹码远比在能够对他们提出的指控定罪之前要多。

sentences.en: conviction on the charges that they brought.
sentences.zh: 他们能够对他们提出的指控定罪。

sentences.en: So the possibility that he will end up cooperating with prosecutors if, in fact, he has information that's damaging to the president has now increased,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他确实掌握了对总统不利的信息，他最终与检察官合作的可能性现在增加了，

sentences.en: as he faces a potentially very long jail term if he doesn't cooperate with them.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他不与他们合作，他可能面临非常漫长的监禁。

sentences.en: So he's now choosing,
sentences.zh: 所以他现在正在选择，

sentences.en: Paul Manafort, for a second time, to flip or to keep fighting.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特，第二次选择，是倒戈还是继续抗争。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Manafort will have to make another bet.
sentences.zh: 而马纳福特将不得不再次下注。

sentences.en: He made a bet that he could get acquitted of the charges that they brought against him if he stood strong and declined to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 他之前赌的是，如果他立场坚定、拒绝合作，就能在针对他的指控中被判无罪。

sentences.en: Now he would have to bet that the president of the United States would pardon him if he does not
sentences.zh: 现在他不得不赌，如果他不合作，美国总统会赦免他，

sentences.en: cooperate, because if he is not pardoned, he's likely to spend a big part of his remaining life in jail.
sentences.zh: 因为如果得不到赦免，他余生的大部分时间很可能要在监狱里度过。

sentences.en: Joe, when Robert Mueller, the special counsel, brought those charges against Manafort, they seem sort of unrelated to the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 乔，当特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒对马纳福特提出这些指控时，它们看起来似乎与“通俄门”调查无关。

sentences.en: Then he doesn't even bring charges against Cohen.
sentences.zh: 而且他甚至没有对科恩提起诉讼。

sentences.en: He hands those off to a different set of prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 他把这些案子移交给了另一组检察官。

sentences.en: But looking at today, I wonder how much of this is really all the work of Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 但回顾今天的情况，我怀疑这其中有多少真的是罗伯特·穆勒的工作成果。

sentences.en: Boy, I wonder too.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我也很怀疑。

sentences.en: It's definitely, for Mueller, by far the best day that he's had.
sentences.zh: 对穆勒来说，这绝对是他迄今为止最棒的一天。

sentences.en: Up until now, he has faced almost a daily barrage of attacks.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他几乎每天都要面对连珠炮般的攻击。

sentences.en: It's a disgraceful situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一种可耻的局面。

sentences.en: It's a total witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一场政治迫害。

sentences.en: I've been saying it for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我早就这么说了。

sentences.en: I've wanted to...
sentences.zh: 我一直想……

sentences.en: From the president, from Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 来自总统，来自鲁迪·朱利安尼。

sentences.en: What do we need to know that this is a totally illegitimate investigation?
sentences.zh: 我们还需要知道什么才能证明这是一场完全非法的调查呢？

sentences.en: From other lawyers and loyalists to the president as pursuing a groundless,
sentences.zh: 来自其他律师和总统的忠实拥护者，他们称这是在进行一场毫无根据的、

sentences.en: politicized witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 政治化的政治迫害。

sentences.en: We have been going through this long national nightmare of the Mueller witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在经历穆勒这场政治迫害带来的漫长的国家噩梦。

sentences.en: And he has not been able to really record any big wins.
sentences.zh: 而他实际上并没有取得任何重大胜利。

sentences.en: Zero evidence of any collusion, no evidence of any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 没有任何勾结的证据，没有任何不法行为的证据。

sentences.en: And yet, the investigation goes on and on and on, and it got really bad today.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查却没完没了地进行下去，而且今天的情况变得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And within two minutes on the same day, he recorded two big wins that will make this day one of the most impactful legal days in the history of the United States political system.
sentences.zh: 但在同一天，他在两分钟内取得了两次重大胜利，这将使今天成为美国政治史上最具影响力的法律日子之一。

sentences.en: This is an enormous boost for Robert Mueller's investigation.
sentences.zh: 这对罗伯特·穆勒的调查是一个巨大的推动。

sentences.en: And interestingly, this is a huge legal victory for Mueller, even though none of this stuff has anything to do with the Russia investigation,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这对穆勒来说是一场巨大的法律胜利，尽管这些事情与“通俄门”调查毫无关系，

sentences.en: technically, the original Russia investigation, interference into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，最初的“通俄门”调查是关于对美国

sentences.en: election, which would seem to suggest that his wide-reaching investigation, this net that was cast so broadly, was quite intentionally done that way.
sentences.zh: 大选的干预，这似乎表明他那广泛的调查，这张撒得如此之大的网，是相当刻意为之的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, both of these cases are tangential.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这两个案件都是旁枝末节。

sentences.en: Neither of them involves the central charges of Russian interference or collusion.
sentences.zh: 它们都不涉及俄罗斯干预或勾结的核心指控。

sentences.en: But the main act in this has yet to fully play out.
sentences.zh: 但这场戏的主角尚未完全登场。

sentences.en: And Mueller's hand is significantly strengthened by the victories that he's been able to put on the board through the legal system.
sentences.zh: 而穆勒通过法律体系取得的胜利，极大地增强了他的筹码。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Now he could have all this leverage when it does come to the main act because of those other cases, which he's now able potentially to kind of take advantage of, to cash in on.
sentences.zh: 现在，当主戏上演时，他可以利用这些其他案件带来的筹码，他现在可能能够利用这些筹码来获利。

sentences.en: That seems absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 这看起来绝对正确。

sentences.en: I believe the legal term for this is turning the screws.
sentences.zh: 我想法律术语管这叫“施压”。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Joe, if you had to sum this day up, the significance of this day for the Trump presidency, what would you say?
sentences.zh: 乔，如果你要总结这一天，总结这一天对特朗普总统任期的意义，你会怎么说？

sentences.en: This was the day that a series of possible charges turned into something that really is a direct legal and direct political threat to Trump's longevity in office.
sentences.zh: 这一天，一系列可能的指控演变成了对特朗普在任时间构成直接法律和政治威胁的事情。

sentences.en: It is quite likely that this will become a central issue in the midterm elections and force voters
sentences.zh: 这很可能成为中期选举的核心议题，并迫使选民

sentences.en: to decide whether or not they want to put Democrats back into majority in the House precisely because
sentences.zh: 决定是否要让民主党重新在众议院获得多数席位，恰恰是因为

sentences.en: impeachment proceedings are the constitutional way to adjudicate a accusation of criminal activity by the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 弹劾程序是裁决美国总统刑事犯罪指控的宪法途径。

sentences.en: And up until now, even Democrats had been reluctant to wave the impeachment flag as part of their campaign in the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 而在此之前，即使是民主党人也不愿在中期选举的竞选中挥舞弹劾大旗。

sentences.en: But you now have the president effectively being an unindicted co-conspirator in a crime.
sentences.zh: 但现在，总统实际上已成为犯罪的未被起诉的同谋。

sentences.en: And it seems highly likely that that then becomes a serious political, if not a direct legal threat to the president.
sentences.zh: 这很可能成为对总统严重的政治威胁，如果不是直接的法律威胁的话。

sentences.en: So this is a historic shift in the nature of the threat that we've been hearing about, writing about, talking about for so many months.
sentences.zh: 所以，这标志着我们几个月来一直在听闻、撰写和谈论的威胁性质发生了历史性的转变。

sentences.en: You're talking impeachment.
sentences.zh: 你在谈论弹劾。

sentences.en: Impeachment is an unavoidable topic.
sentences.zh: 弹劾是一个不可避免的话题。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean he will be impeached.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他一定会被弹劾。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that if he is impeached, he will be convicted.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着如果他被弹劾，他就一定会被定罪。

sentences.en: But it is an unavoidable topic when the president is an unindicted co-conspirator in a crime.
sentences.zh: 但当总统成为犯罪的未被起诉的同谋时，这是一个不可避免的话题。

sentences.en: That is the constitutional mechanism for adjudicating a credible accusation of illegal activity by the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是裁决美国总统非法活动可信指控的宪法机制。

sentences.en: Well, Joe Khan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔·卡恩，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday afternoon, President Trump was asked about Cohen and Manafort as he left his plane for a campaign rally in West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 周二下午，特朗普总统在离开飞机前往西弗吉尼亚州参加竞选集会时，被问及科恩和马纳福特的问题。

sentences.en: Trump ignored questions about Cohen, who entered a guilty plea, but offered praise for Manafort, who is still deciding whether to cooperate with the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 特朗普无视了关于已认罪的科恩的问题，但对仍在决定是否与特别检察官合作的马纳福特表示了赞赏。

sentences.en: Paul Manafort's a good man.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特是个好人。

sentences.en: He was the brother.
sentences.zh: 他就像兄弟一样。

sentences.en: Calling him, quote, a good man.
sentences.zh: 称他为“好人”。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Mr. President, what about Michael?
sentences.zh: 总统先生，迈克尔的情况怎么样？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Microsoft says it has discovered a Russian hacking operation targeting conservative think tanks in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 微软表示，它发现了一起针对美国保守派智库的俄罗斯黑客行动。

sentences.en: That have criticized Russia's president, its oligarchs, and its human rights record.
sentences.zh: 这些智库曾批评俄罗斯总统、其寡头及其人权记录。

sentences.en: The company said it traced the operation to the GRU, the same Russian intelligence unit responsible for interfering in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 该公司表示，已追踪到该行动源自格鲁乌（GRU），即负责干预2016年大选的同一个俄罗斯情报部门。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the choice of Republican-leaning groups suggests Russia's goal is to disrupt any U.S.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，选择亲共和党的团体表明俄罗斯的目标是破坏任何挑战普京的美国

sentences.en: institution, on the left or right, that challenges Putin.
sentences.zh: 机构，无论是左派还是右派。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 还有

sentences.en: Good morning and thank you all for joining this call.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好，感谢大家参加这次电话会议。

sentences.en: As part of President Trump's executive order to promote energy independence, he directed
sentences.zh: 作为特朗普总统推动能源独立行政令的一部分，他指示

sentences.en: EPA to review the Clean Power Plan and repeal, replace, or revise it.
sentences.zh: 环保署审查《清洁电力计划》，并废除、替换或修订它。

sentences.en: Today, we are fulfilling the president's agenda.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们正在落实总统的议程。

sentences.en: The Trump administration released new, relaxed rules for emissions by coal-burning power plants
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府周二发布了针对燃煤电厂排放的新型宽松规定，

sentences.en: on Tuesday that would replace President Obama's plan to sharply reduce such emissions by closing the plants.
sentences.zh: 这将取代奥巴马总统通过关闭电厂来大幅减少此类排放的计划。

sentences.en: According to the agency's own analysis, the rules will lead to almost 50,000 new cases of asthma, 20,000 missed school dates, and up to 1,400 premature deaths from heart and lung
sentences.zh: 根据该机构自己的分析，这些规定每年将导致近5万例新增哮喘病例、2万次缺课，以及多达1400例因心脏和肺部

sentences.en: disease every year.
sentences.zh: 疾病导致的过早死亡。

sentences.en: We are proposing a better plan, the Affordable Clean Energy, or ACE, rule.
sentences.zh: 我们正在提议一项更好的计划，即“负担得起的清洁能源”（ACE）规则。

sentences.en: It respects the rule of law and will enable states to build affordable, clean, and reliable energy portfolios.
sentences.zh: 它尊重法治，并将使各州能够建立负担得起、清洁且可靠的能源组合。

sentences.en: The error of top-down, one-size-fits-all, federal mandates is over.
sentences.zh: 自上而下、一刀切的联邦强制令时代已经结束了。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require, because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
